findings.title: Continue button not confirmed by page facts
findings.expected: Checkout step one shows Cancel and Continue buttons, as the agent report states.

It may be an input[type=submit] whose value does not appear in innerText, which would be a limitation of the facts rather than an app fault.

ai_review.reasoning: The finding is that the Continue button is not in the page's visible_text, while the agent report says both Cancel and Continue are present. No screenshot is attached to this finding, so I cannot visually confirm either way. The page facts list 'Cancel' but not 'Continue'. The likely cause is that on SauceDemo the Continue control is an input[type=submit] with value="Continue". innerText does not include input values, so the fact extractor would miss it while the button is actually rendered. The agent's own report is consistent with a normal checkout-step-one page, and the step itself (reaching checkout-step-one with badge 2 and empty fields) is consistent with the expected flow. Nothing here shows a wrong total, a lost form value or a blocked checkout, so it does not touch F1-F7 in any way that would fail the run. The fact extractor's own note (type=suspicious, confidence=low) points the same way. The finding is best read as a limitation of the page facts rather than an app fault. Reviewing one screenshot of step 4 would settle it quickly.

ai_review.reasoning: No screenshot is attached to this finding, so the claim cannot be checked visually. The description is internally contradictory. It says the Fleece Jacket detail page already showed "Remove" and badge 1 on arrival, and then that "Add to cart" was clicked. If the button already read "Remove", there was nothing to add, and the cart contents were never captured (items list empty), so the click's effect on the cart is unconfirmed. Two readings fit. (a) The agent misread the page state, which would make this a false positive, probably with the jacket added on an earlier step or the button label misread. (b) The jacket was already in the cart before the test step, which points to stale cart state carried over from earlier in the run or from a previous session. That would be a test-setup or state-isolation question, not a clear F2 failure. The report is also unfinished: the path notes are cut off, and the badge value after "Remove" was not captured. Neither reading can be confirmed from this text. Suggested next step: re-run from a clean login with the cart confirmed empty, capture the Fleece Jacket page with its button label and badge before and after the click, and read the cart. Severity is observation at most, since F2 is not confirmed as broken.
